title: Studio flow designer ignores the package's translations: zh-CN shows the flow's English label and English approval-step labels a package ships translated
body:
repo:hotcrm#1 · huangyiirene · session_01J8VVAnPkgK6CWrJa6t7Fk5

Found by the hotcrm lane while re-capturing the large-deal approval screenshot for hotcrm#2605 (PR hotcrm#2613) on @objectstack 18.5.0, signed in with zh-CN. Read in code on objectstack `main` fc5913e117.

## What happens

hotcrm ships `flows.opportunity_approval.label: '大额商机审批'` and `approvals.manager_review.label` / `approvals.director_signoff.label` in its zh-CN pack (hotcrm `src/sales/translations/zh-CN/app.ts` 567–572; the keys are the spec's, pinned in `packages/spec/src/system/translation.test.ts` ~1761). The Studio flow designer still shows "Large Deal Approval", the approval nodes' English labels, and English edge labels.

## Why, in code

`ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/metadata-admin/previews/` (FlowPreview, FlowCanvas, flow-canvas-parts) localizes node **types** (`translateNodeLabel` reads `engine.flowNode.<type>.label` from the studio catalogue, `metadata-admin/i18n.ts` ~592) and flow meta tokens, and renders the authored `label` as is (`selection.label ?? selection.id`, FlowPreview ~143–150). Nothing there reads the package bundle's `flows.<flow>.*` translations. The spec's `flows.<flow>` group (`packages/spec/src/system/translation.zod.ts` ~1929) has keys for screens, refusals, approvals, notices and records, but none for a decision or other node's label or for an edge label, so a package cannot ship those at all.

## Asked

Decide which of these Studio shows translated (it is an authoring surface, so source labels may be intended; then say so and show the translation beside it). At least the flow label and approval-step labels, which the spec lets a package translate, appear in the viewer's language where a translation exists. Say whether node and edge labels get keys.

## Done when

A zh-CN admin opening opportunity_approval in Studio reads 大额商机审批 and the two translated step labels, or the doc says why not.
